title: Tempo Event
description: One element of the `events` array returned by GET /v1/events.

start.description: Start of the event as an RFC 9557 IXDTF string: RFC 3339 date-time plus a time-zone suffix and optional calendar tag.

start_utc.description: Start of the event as a UTC instant.

end.description: End of the event in the venue's local offset.

received_at.description: Server receipt time of this response, UTC, millisecond precision.

all_day_date.description: Calendar date of an all-day event.

source_seen_at.description: For partner-feed events: when the partner last saw the event.
